name: daily-board-drain

message.content: This is the daily unattended board-drain routine for kimgranlund/claude-plugins (idr-0011 estate rhythm, gh#626's first standing schedule). Run /mobilize-chores auto against this repo's own root: it fans out the ops sweep, then drives every buildable ticket the sweep surfaces through a full build dispatch, confirm-free (the leading 'auto' token). Do not widen scope beyond what /mobilize-chores auto itself does — no manual ticket picking, no interactive prompts (there is no one to answer them). If the sweep finds nothing buildable, report that plainly; do not invent work. This routine's own definition and the cadence it runs on are tunable living state at .claude/ops/calendar.md — if that file's 'Daily board drain' row is ever retired or its cadence changed, a human updates this routine (via /schedule) to match rather than leaving it drifted.
